en.seoTitle: Julius Brussee Caveman Skills: Concision, Investigation & Refactoring
en.seoDescription: Explore selected Skills in Julius Brussee's Caveman project. Distinguish the Caveman response Skill from its proxy and discover evidence-first investigation and safe refactoring instructions.
en.heroTitle: Caveman Skills beyond the short-response mode
en.heroDescription: Julius Brussee's Caveman project is more than one terse-writing instruction. Explore the published Skills for concise responses, evidence-first diagnosis, and careful code restructuring.
en.listDescription: Caveman changes response style; Investigate First changes how a failure is examined; Safe Refactor changes how structural edits are verified. They should not be conflated with the project's proxy or extensions.
en.checksIntro: The repository's name suggests brevity, but its engineering Skills also emphasize diagnosis and verification.

checks.title: Shorter answers
checks.body: Caveman is a response-style Skill. Its purpose is to remove filler while keeping commands, numbers, warnings, and technical meaning intact.

checks.title: Unclear failures
checks.body: Investigate First is for unknown causes and intermittent issues. It calls for evidence before a code edit.

checks.title: Structural cleanup
checks.body: Safe Refactor fits extraction and consolidation where behavior must stay stable. Verify before and after the change.

en.boundaryTitle: Skills are only one layer of Caveman
en.boundaryDescription: The upstream repository also contains proxy, extension, hook, and other software components. This directory links to three actual SKILL.md files; it does not present the entire project as a Skill or promise its tools are installed.

faq.question: Is the entire Caveman project one Skill?
faq.answer: No. The project includes multiple Skills plus separate proxy, extension, hook, and other code. This page identifies specific Skill files.

faq.question: Does Caveman remove important technical details?
faq.answer: The published Skill explicitly aims to preserve facts, commands, paths, numbers, errors, and warnings while cutting filler.

faq.question: When should I use Investigate First?
faq.answer: When a failure's cause is uncertain, intermittent, or tied to performance and editing immediately would be speculative.

faq.question: Will Safe Refactor guarantee no regression?
faq.answer: No instruction can guarantee that. Its workflow calls for verification around structural edits to reduce the risk.

faq.question: Does installing a Skill install the Caveman proxy?
faq.answer: No. A Skill is an instruction file. The project's proxy and extensions have separate setup and behavior.

en.ctaTitle: Keep the evidence beside the edit

zh.listTitle: 同一个仓库，三种不同指令

zh.checksIntro: 仓库名称强调简洁，但其中的工程 Skill 同样重视诊断与验证。

checks.title: 缩短回复

checks.title: 原因不明的故障
checks.body: Investigate First 面向未知原因和间歇性问题，要求在修改代码前收集证据。

checks.title: 结构性清理
checks.body: Safe Refactor 适合代码提取与合并，强调改动前后验证行为是否保持稳定。

zh.boundaryTitle: Skill 只是 Caveman 项目的一层

faq.question: 整个 Caveman 项目就是一个 Skill 吗？
faq.answer: 不是。项目包含多项 Skill，以及独立的代理、扩展、钩子等代码。本页只介绍明确的 Skill 文件。

faq.question: Caveman 会删掉重要技术细节吗？
faq.answer: 上游指令明确要求保留事实、命令、路径、数值、错误和警告，只压缩冗余表达。

faq.question: 何时使用 Investigate First？
faq.answer: 故障原因未知、偶发或涉及性能时，应先取证，而不是立即猜测并修改。

faq.question: Safe Refactor 能保证零回归吗？
faq.answer: 任何指令都无法保证。它通过结构性修改前后的验证降低风险。

faq.question: 安装 Skill 会安装 Caveman 代理吗？
faq.answer: 不会。Skill 是指令文件；项目的代理和扩展有各自的安装与行为。
